typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		HRA_Detail_Primary_Key as string,
		Assessment_Type_ID as string,
		Assessment_Type as string,
		Date_Screening_Began as string,
		Date_Screening_Completed as string,
		Date_Previous_PCP_Visit as string,
		CC_Substance_Abuse as string,
		CC_Diabetes as string,
		CC_Mental_Health as string,
		CC_Heart_Disease as string,
		CC_Cancer_or_Leukemia as string,
		CC_High_Blood_Pressure as string,
		CC_COPD as string,
		CC_HIV_AIDS as string,
		CC_Depression as string,
		CC_Kidney_Disorder as string,
		CC_Asthma as string,
		CC_Transplant as string,
		Pregnancy_Identifier as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  HRA_Detail_Primary_Key ,Medicaid_ID ,Assessment_Type_ID ,Assessment_Type ,Date_Screening_Began ,Date_Screening_Completed ,Date_Previous_PCP_Visit ,CC_Substance_Abuse ,CC_Diabetes ,CC_Mental_Health ,CC_Heart_Disease ,CC_Cancer_or_Leukemia ,CC_High_Blood_Pressure ,CC_COPD ,CC_HIV_AIDS ,CC_Depression ,CC_Kidney_Disorder ,CC_Asthma ,CC_Transplant ,Pregnancy_Identifier FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[KANCARE_HRAM_EXTRACT] ORDER BY Medicaid_ID, Date_Screening_Began',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableKANCAREHRAMEXTRACT
SourceTableKANCAREHRAMEXTRACT derive(Medicaid_ID = Medicaid_ID) ~> PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount
PlaceHolderSuccessRowCount sink(input(
		CC_Asthma as string,
		Date_Screening_Completed as string,
		CC_Substance_Abuse as string,
		CC_Cancer_or_Leukemia as string,
		CC_High_Blood_Pressure as string,
		Pregnancy_Identifier as string,
		HRA_Detail_Primary_Key as string,
		CC_HIV_AIDS as string,
		Assessment_Type_ID as string,
		CC_COPD as string,
		CC_Kidney_Disorder as string,
		CC_Transplant as string,
		CC_Depression as string,
		CC_Diabetes as string,
		Assessment_Type as string,
		Date_Screening_Began as string,
		CC_Mental_Health as string,
		CC_Heart_Disease as string,
		Medicaid_ID as string,
		Date_Previous_PCP_Visit as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CC_Asthma,
		Date_Screening_Completed,
		CC_Substance_Abuse,
		CC_Cancer_or_Leukemia,
		CC_High_Blood_Pressure,
		Pregnancy_Identifier,
		HRA_Detail_Primary_Key,
		CC_HIV_AIDS,
		Assessment_Type_ID,
		CC_COPD,
		CC_Kidney_Disorder,
		CC_Transplant,
		CC_Depression,
		CC_Diabetes,
		Assessment_Type,
		Date_Screening_Began,
		CC_Mental_Health,
		CC_Heart_Disease,
		Medicaid_ID,
		Date_Previous_PCP_Visit)) ~> TargetKanCareLTSMFile
